summary: Fyers drops the HSM socket: the feed signs in again, subscribes again after the K, an update for a topic id of the old connection is ignored, and the next snapshot carries the quote again.

deviations.reason: The web's Fyers adapter stamps timestamp with int(time.time()), epoch seconds; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends them.
The record carries no OI for this equity; the web sends oi 0 (fyers_data.get('OI', 0)), the desktop leaves it out.
